caption: Sample NM
shows: A sample NM on the public site: the message window (title 'Notices to Mariners') with the map of a line of numbered, named positions, the original-information star, the number badge with (P), a reference, a details part with a position table, a note, charts, a publication and the source line
steps: In a 1280x2000 window (the panel shows the whole message without scrolling), open /messages/details/message/<uid of NM-550-26, or the first published NM that fits needsData>: the link opens the message window over the Details view; zoom the window's map in on the message's positions (the window fits it only as far as zoom 12, where the five positions lie on one spot), as a reader does with +; wait for the map tiles and the position labels
crop: the message dialog panel (.dialog-panel), whole height
needsData: a published NM, English throughout, with original information, a reference, a position table, a note part, a chart, a publication text, a source and a line or an area whose positions carry English names (NM-550-26 in niord_guides)
note: Taken by integration-docs.shots.ts. A different message from presentation's MessageGeometry.png (a point), so the two documents do not show the same picture. The data has no temporary NM with two position-table parts, a note and a polygon at once; NM-584-26 (three parts, a polygon) has twelve positions with one long name each, whose labels pile up on the map, so a preliminary notice with five positions on a line is shown instead, the only published NM in niord_guides that fits needsData. Its positions lie within about 200 m: at the window's own zoom 12 they are one blot, so the map is zoomed in to about 16, where positions 1 to 4 and their names stand apart; position 5 lies 65 m west of position 4 and only 20 m further south, and its pin sits partly under position 4's name at every zoom that keeps all five in the map. The window's footer has previous/next, a print button and Close.
